jobs.occupation: Design Operations Lead Portfolio and Practice
jobs.description:
On behalf of a partner company, Nordic Investin is looking for a Design Operations Lead Portfolio and Practice. You connect user evidence, service realities and product constraints to create experiences that are clear, inclusive and valuable.
The partner is strengthening its capability in design operations that improve planning quality and collaboration at scale. You will connect portfolio planning, design rituals and tooling while ensuring that quality reviews and supplier coordination receive appropriate discipline. The aim is practical progress that colleagues can use, leaders can evaluate and the organisation can sustain.
The design function values evidence, critique and collaboration. Success means making complexity understandable and enabling better choices.
How you will work
You will work with users, product leaders, engineers and operational colleagues. Design decisions should be tested early and explained through evidence.
This role calls for visible leadership and disciplined decision making. You are expected to make trade-offs visible, recognise when a decision needs wider expertise and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.
What you will do
Own the practical direction for design operations that improve planning quality and collaboration at scale.
Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for portfolio planning and design rituals.
Establish useful standards, routines or decision artefacts around tooling.
Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting quality reviews.
Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve supplier coordination.
Strengthen knowledge sharing and sustainable ownership through capability building.
What you will bring
Relevant experience delivering design operations that improve planning quality and collaboration at scale in a demanding environment.
Strong working knowledge of portfolio planning and design rituals.
Practical experience applying tooling and quality reviews.
Ability to assess priorities, risks and trade-offs involving supplier coordination.
Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.
Experience that would add value
Experience from mature design organisations.
Exposure to capability building in a cross-functional or multi-team environment.
Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.
A background that can succeed here
You may come from a product company, agency, consultancy or public service. Your portfolio should explain the problem, contribution, evidence and outcome. Direct experience of design operations that improve planning quality and collaboration at scale is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.
What makes the opportunity interesting
You will work on consequential journeys where careful discovery can influence priorities, not simply presentation. The focus on design operations that improve planning quality and collaboration at scale gives the opportunity a clear mission and room to influence priorities and success measures.
The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.
The recruitment conversation
Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to ask direct questions and test whether the role, mandate and partner environment are right for you.
How to apply
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant product, service or customer journey you helped improve. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside formal titles.
